name: create_activity
description: Create a new activity record with start time, end time, category and description. Use this to log what the user did during a specific time period.

start_time.description: Activity start time in format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' or 'YYYY-MM-DD'

end_time.description: Activity end time in format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' or 'YYYY-MM-DD'

description.description: Detailed description of what the user did

name: get_activities
description: Get list of activities for a specific day. Returns activities sorted by start time.

limit.description: Maximum number of activities to return (default: 10)

day_offset.description: Day offset: 0 for today, -1 for yesterday, 1 for tomorrow (default: 0)

name: update_activity
description: Update an existing activity. Can update start time, end time, category, or description.

activity_id.description: ID of the activity to update

start_time.description: New start time in format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'

end_time.description: New end time in format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'

name: delete_activity
description: Delete an activity by its ID.

activity_id.description: ID of the activity to delete

name: get_all_exercises
description: Get all exercises from the database with their details (muscle group, equipment, category).

name: find_exercise
description: Search for exercises by name, muscle group, equipment, or category. Returns matching exercises sorted by relevance.

search_term.description: Search term to find exercises (e.g., 'bench press', 'chest', 'barbell')

name: create_exercise
description: Create a new exercise in the database. Exercise name must be unique.

name: update_exercise
description: Update an existing exercise details.

exercise_id.description: ID of the exercise to update

name: delete_exercise
description: Delete an exercise from the database.

exercise_id.description: ID of the exercise to delete

name: create_workout
description: Log a workout with exercise, sets, reps, and optional weight and timestamp.

timestamp.description: Workout timestamp in format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS' (optional, defaults to now)

name: get_workouts
description: Get workout history for a specific day with exercise names.

day_offset.description: Day offset: 0 for today, -1 for yesterday (default: 0)

name: update_workout
description: Update an existing workout record. Can update exercise, sets, reps, weight, or timestamp.

workout_id.description: ID of the workout to update

name: delete_workout
description: Delete a workout record by its ID.

workout_id.description: ID of the workout to delete

name: get_time
description: Get current date and time as a string in format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'.

name: get_all_windows
description: Get list of all open windows and applications on the user's system.

name: get_current_window_title
description: Get the currently active window title and application name.

name: close_browser
description: Close all web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari). Use this when user is procrastinating on social media or distracting websites.

name: close_app
description: Close a specific application by name. Use this to close distracting apps.

app_name.description: Name of the application to close (e.g., 'Telegram', 'Discord', 'Slack')

name: log_monitoring
description: Log current windows and tabs for monitoring purposes. Internal function.

windows_and_tabs.description: String containing current windows and tabs information

name: get_monitoring_logs
description: Get monitoring logs for a specific time period to analyze user's activity patterns.

hours_back.description: Number of hours back to retrieve logs (default: 4)

day_offset.description: Day offset: 0 for today, -1 for yesterday (default: 0)

name: get_memory
description: Get user's memory and preferences. Contains important context about user's habits, goals, and preferences.

name: update_memory
description: Replace entire user memory with new content. Use this to completely rewrite memory.

name: add_to_memory
description: Append new information to user's memory. Use this to remember important facts about user's preferences, goals, or habits.
